expertise: You are an expert in extracting structured numerical data from scientific graphs.
objective: Extract every visible data series from the graph into a structured JSON.

definitions.series_name: The name of a plotted series, exactly as shown in the legend or directly on the graph.
definitions.x_axis_label: The exact label of the horizontal axis.
definitions.y_axis_label: The exact label of the vertical axis.
definitions.data_point: A pair consisting of one x-value and its corresponding y-value.
definitions.missing_value: If a value cannot be read confidently, use "N/A" instead of estimating.

instructions: STEP 1 — Determine how many data series are present in the graph.
STEP 2 — Read the x-axis label exactly as shown.
STEP 3 — Read the y-axis label exactly as shown.
4.1 Read the series name exactly as shown.
4.2 Identify every visible data point from left to right.
4.3 Pair each x-value with its corresponding y-value.
4.4 If either coordinate cannot be read confidently, replace only that value with "N/A".
STEP 5 — Verify that every x-axis array has exactly the same number of elements as its corresponding y-axis array.
STEP 6 — Verify that all labels match the graph exactly, converting only superscripts and subscripts into plain text.
STEP 7 — Verify that no series is omitted.
STEP 8 — Return only the JSON object using the format below.
Never include any keys other than those defined by the format.
